description: This file defines controller functions for managing user profiles in a Node.js Express application, including CRUD operations and search functionalities, interacting with a MongoDB database via Mongoose.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Fetches all profiles from the database, sorted by ID in descending order.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves a single profile by its ID.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a new profile document in the database with data from the request body.

methods.name: getProfilesByUser
methods.description: Fetches a profile associated with a specific user ID provided in query parameters.

methods.name: getProfilesBySearch
methods.description: Searches profiles by name or email matching a search query, case-insensitive.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates an existing profile identified by ID with new data from the request body.

methods.name: deleteProfile
methods.description: Deletes a profile by its ID.
